title: Synchronize targetless System wheel return at Galaxy anchor

scope.subject: Correct only the targetless System-to-Galaxy wheel endpoint; preserve the retained native bridge and pointer takeover.

research_summary: A/B on exact #183: retained-target deep-link reverses 1 to 0, while a Search-opened targetless route changes phase to Galaxy but leaves 1.000 and then blocks outward input on no-galaxy-focus. The existing generic phase effect intentionally preserves frozen partial values for pointer takeover. Use the existing synchronous scale publisher at the distinct user-driven targetless fallback, as observed in the current handler. This change is separate from unproven WebGL shader 21.

sources.finding: Current pinned native renderer remains the authority; no upstream patch or new camera.
The installed ref-backed state pattern keeps one imperative coordinate with React as a mirror.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep the installed MIT YEIS and current camera entry/return behaviors; not a renderer replacement.
Keep the existing R3F Canvas and React phase state, no new scene or camera.
Retain the current wheel dispatcher, phase switch and normalized coordinate publisher.
Use the same publishWorldScalePosition helper and existing Galaxy anchor; do not touch the generic pointer-takeover effect.

candidates.name: Existing continuous-scale publisher and Galaxy anchor
candidates.source: Existing UniverseApp and continuousScale implementation, #183 exact source
candidates.license: Project code plus existing MIT camera dependency
candidates.reason: Reuse same imperative source of truth; synchronize the endpoint on the route where the native retained target does not exist.

candidates.name: Force anchor on all Galaxy phase entries
candidates.source: Potential rewrite of the default phase effect
candidates.reason: Would reset manual pointer takeover and valid retained-target partial positions; too broad.

decision.rationale: Reuse the existing scale coordinate publisher and Galaxy anchor only in the targetless System wheel return. Preserve the retained-target branch and general phase/pointer behavior.
decision.fallback: Keep isolated until exact fail-before/fix-after and existing navigation controls pass.
